sections.heading: Scope
paragraphs: Finance reviewed software subscriptions due for renewal in November and December. Five renewals had confirmed owners. One monitoring tool needed an updated data handling review before approval.

sections.heading: Decision
paragraphs: Renew approved subscriptions for the current seat count. Defer extra licenses until the owner provides active usage data. A vendor change that adds customer information follows SEC-004.

sections.heading: Follow-up
paragraphs: The procurement coordinator updates the renewal register by 4 November and schedules reminders 45 days before each next renewal.
